Welcome to Fenjan!

Your beloved dinosaur that helps you to find your desired positions, while you enjoy a cup of coffee.

Fenajan is a tool designed to assist you in finding your dream job, Ph.D. position or any right to the point post. App core and idea by: Hue (MohammadHossein) Salari

Developed by: Vahid Kosari

Fenajan is a tool designed to assist you in finding your dream job, Ph.D. position or any right to the point post. We understand that searching through social media platforms positions can be tedious and time-consuming. That's why we have developed Fenjan, it simplifies the process and saves your valuable time.

Fenjan is expertly crafted to scour the latest posts and tweets on Twitter and LinkedIn, bringing you the most recent Ph.D. positions in your field. This ensures that you are always up-to-date and won't miss any opportunity.

The information is delivered to you via a user-friendly email feature, guaranteeing you have immediate access to the data you need, so you can focus on your research and leave the rest to us. We look forward to supporting you on your academic journey.
